eyebrow: A resource monitor on the ETL warehouse
code:
CREATE RESOURCE MONITOR driftwood_etl_monitor
  WITH CREDIT_QUOTA = 50
  FREQUENCY = MONTHLY
  TRIGGERS
    ON 75 PERCENT DO NOTIFY
    ON 100 PERCENT DO SUSPEND;

ALTER WAREHOUSE driftwood_etl_wh
  SET RESOURCE_MONITOR = driftwood_etl_monitor;
caption: 75% notifies early; 100% is the real guardrail -- the warehouse stops accepting queries.
A real Snowsight CREATE RESOURCE MONITOR statement succeeding -- the same mechanism Driftwood's ETL warehouse uses.

eyebrow: Alerting when the DAG itself fails
caption: A failed run after retries pages the data team that same morning -- not a silently stale dashboard.
A real Snowsight query-result grid grouping credits by warehouse -- confirming ETL and BI cost separately, as designed.
A real Admin > Warehouses tab -- size and suspended state for every warehouse, the first place to look.
